title: COVERAGE.json — one row per input APN, keyed by apn_norm
description: UNEVALUATED means we never looked. Conflating 'we looked and rejected it' with 'we never looked' is the easiest way for a coverage report to lie. Every input APN MUST appear here; delivery_gate.py blocks a workbook with an APN that has no disposition.

run_id.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.

retrieved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, second precision, Z-suffixed. Computed at emit time, never hardcoded.

kpi.description: Acceptance bar: classified mobiles / non-suppressed owner rows >= 0.50.

apn_norm.description: Populated, or an explicit reason token (UNKNOWN, UNEVALUATED, EXPLICITLY-UNAVAILABLE, NOT-APPLICABLE). Never an empty string.
